_comment: Escape hatch for the string scanner. Everything here is applied on top of
the heuristics in scan_strings.py, so a mistake found in a translation
review can be pinned without editing code. CI reads this file on every run.
exclude_files        : regexes matched against the path relative to lib/
exclude_strings      : exact English strings to never translate
include_strings      : exact English strings to always translate, even when
the context heuristics would have skipped them
extra_named_args     : named arguments to treat as UI text
extra_callees        : constructors whose positional arg is UI text
banned_named_args    : named arguments to never treat as UI text
exclude_strings: Internet Archive: Digital Library of Free & Borrowable Texts, Movies, Music & Wayback Machine
